shortDescription: Manage MDM cluster on Dell PowerFlex

options.name: clear_interfaces
options.description: Clear all virtual IP interfaces. The I(clear_interfaces) is mutually exclusive with I(virtual_ip_interfaces).

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: is_primary
options.description: Set I(is_primary) as C(true) to change MDM cluster ownership from the current master MDM to different MDM. Set I(is_primary) as C(false), will return MDM cluster details. New owner MDM must be an MDM with a manager role.

options.name: mdm
options.description: Specifies parameters to add/remove MDMs to/from the MDM cluster.

options.name: mdm_id
options.description: The ID of the MDM. Mutually exclusive with I(mdm_name).

options.name: mdm_name
options.description: The name of the MDM. It is unique across the PowerFlex array. Mutually exclusive with I(mdm_id). If mdm_name passed in add standby operation, then same name will be assigned to the new standby mdm.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: performance_profile
options.description: Apply performance profile to cluster MDMs.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: virtual_ip_interfaces
options.description: List of interfaces to be used for virtual IPs. The order of interfaces must be matched with virtual IPs assigned to the cluster. Interfaces of the primary and secondary type MDMs are allowed to modify. The I(virtual_ip_interfaces) is mutually exclusive with I(clear_interfaces).
